summary: Your West Bay firm covers corporate, family and labour work, but repeated blog text, dead app buttons and an exposed login link make the site look unfinished.

findings.problem: Five blog posts (QFC, Corporate Taxation, Foreign Ownership, Judicial Enforcement, Labour Law) show the same Mergers and acquisitions excerpt. The Directors' Liability summary is generic filler.
findings.cost: Mismatched excerpts make a law firm look careless.
findings.fix: Unique, accurate summaries for every post.

findings.problem: The Apple Store and Google Play buttons both link to /consultation/, and the Arabic toggle, the Privacy Policy link and several icons link to #.
findings.cost: Buttons that go to the wrong place lose clients and break trust.
findings.fix: Remove the app buttons or link them properly, and fix every # link.

findings.problem: The contact form shows Case Type and consent but no name or email field appears. There is no WhatsApp, and the first number is labelled Emergency call.
findings.cost: A client who cannot complete the form moves to another firm.
findings.fix: A complete enquiry form and a WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: A footer link Contact Law likely means Contract Law, a plugin banner (Optimized by Seraphinite Accelerator) shows, and a /glf-admin-login/ sign in link sits on the public page. No testimonials appear.
findings.cost: Leftovers and an exposed login signal an unmaintained site.
findings.fix: Clean footer, no public login link, and client testimonials.

redesign: A complete enquiry form, WhatsApp and click to call on every page.
Unique service and blog content, client testimonials and a clean, secure footer.
